description: Source code for a video encoder delegate handling AV1 encoding via VAAPI, including functions for preparing bitstream OBUs, sequence headers, frame parameters, and rate control.

classes.name: AV1VaapiVideoEncoderDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class for AV1 video encoding using VAAPI, managing sequence headers, frame parameters, bitstream OBUs, and rate control.

classes.name: PackedData
classes.description: Helper class for writing packed bitstream data, including OBU headers and Leb128 encoding.

methods.name: ComputeLevel
methods.description: Calculates the AV1 level index based on resolution and framerate.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a value with specified bits into the packed bitstream.

methods.name: WriteBool
methods.description: Writes a boolean value as a single bit into the packed bitstream.

methods.name: WriteOBUHeader
methods.description: Writes an OBU header with specified type, extension, and size flags.

methods.name: EncodeLeb128
methods.description: Encodes a 32-bit unsigned integer as Leb128 with optional fixed size.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the queued bits into a byte vector.

methods.name: OutstandingBits
methods.description: Returns the number of outstanding bits not yet flushed.

methods.name: SubmitPackedData
methods.description: Submits a vector of packed bitstream data as VAAPI buffers.

methods.name: GetAV1Picture
methods.description: Retrieves the AV1Picture object from an EncodeJob.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encoder delegate with configuration, computes level, and sets up parameters.

methods.name: UpdateRates
methods.description: Updates rate control parameters for encoding.

methods.name: GetCodedSize
methods.description: Returns the coded size of the video frames.

methods.name: GetMaxNumOfRefFrames
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of reference frames supported.

methods.name: GetSVCLayerResolutions
methods.description: Returns resolutions for SVC layers.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for an encode job, including QP.

methods.name: PrepareEncodeJob
methods.description: Prepares an encode job by submitting necessary OBUs and frame parameters.

methods.name: BitrateControlUpdate
methods.description: Updates rate control after encoding a chunk.

methods.name: SubmitTemporalDelimiter
methods.description: Submits a temporal delimiter OBU.

methods.name: SubmitSequenceHeader
methods.description: Submits sequence header OBUs.

methods.name: SubmitSequenceParam
methods.description: Submits sequence parameters buffer.

methods.name: SubmitSequenceHeaderOBU
methods.description: Submits sequence header OBU with packed sequence data.

methods.name: PackSequenceHeader
methods.description: Creates a packed sequence header OBUs.

methods.name: SubmitFrame
methods.description: Submits a frame OBU with picture parameters.

methods.name: FillPictureParam
methods.description: Fills VAEncPictureParameterBufferAV1 with frame and reference info.

methods.name: SubmitFrameOBU
methods.description: Submits a frame OBU with frame header data.

methods.name: PackFrameHeader
methods.description: Creates a packed frame header for a frame.

methods.name: SubmitPictureParam
methods.description: Submits picture parameters buffer.

methods.name: SubmitTileGroup
methods.description: Submits tile group buffer.
